title: The Undead Arise
description: The Undead Arise is a hardcore zombie apocalypse modpack where survival is everything.
body:
Survive the outbreak. Reclaim the ruins. Trust no one.
7
☣️ About the Modpack

INFECTED EARTH is a hardcore zombie apocalypse survival modpack built for players who want a dark, intense, and realistic experience.

The world has fallen. Cities are abandoned. Something far worse than zombies now roams the land…

You must:

Scavenge for food and supplies
Survive extreme temperatures and thirst
Fight evolving infected creatures
Build and defend your base
Explore ruined cities full of danger
⚠️ Key Features
🧟 Dynamic Zombie & Parasite Threats
Intelligent, aggressive enemies that hunt you
Mutations and evolving parasites
Massive hordes that attack your base
🌆 Fully Ruined World
Explore massive abandoned cities
Loot destroyed buildings and hidden bunkers
Every structure tells a story
🌡️ Realistic Survival System
Temperature, thirst, and seasons
Limited resources → every decision matters
Harsh early-game survival
🔫 Combat & Defense
Guns, melee weapons, and advanced combat
Base defense systems and traps
Strategic survival gameplay
⚙️ Balanced Progression
Start with nothing → build up slowly
Limited tech to keep survival challenging
Quest system to guide your journey
🎧 Immersive Atmosphere
Dark nights and realistic lighting
Horror sound design
Enhanced visuals with shaders support
🧠 Difficulty

⚠️ Hard / Hardcore Recommended

This modpack is designed to be:

Challenging
Unforgiving
Rewarding
💻 Performance
Optimized for smooth gameplay
Includes performance mods
Recommended: 8GB+ RAM
🎯 Who Is This For?

✔️ Hardcore survival players
✔️ Zombie apocalypse fans
✔️ Players who enjoy challenge & progression
✔️ Fans of horror and immersive gameplay

🚀 Tips for New Players
Do NOT go out at night early on
Secure shelter immediately
Manage thirst and temperature
Avoid large cities until prepared
🔥 Final Words

This is not just a modpack…
It’s a fight for survival in a dead world.

How long will you last?
